input.title: Split "-" into child
input.body:
Extend the `splitSentence` command to handle this extra use case. If we find they need to be orthogonal we can separate it out into its own command.

# Case 1: Split into child

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- one - 1
```

Activate Split Sentences on the thought.

## Current Behavior

Cannot split sentences: thought is an empty thought or has only one sentence.

## Expected Behavior

Split on `-`, `–`, or `—` (dash, en-dash, or em-dash) and insert the right half as a child of the thought.

```
- one
  - 1
```

# Case 2: Split sentence

If a thought has both dash and multiple sentences, the current Split Sentence behavior should take precedence.

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- one - 1. two. three.
```

Activate Split Sentences on the thought.

## Current Behavior

```
- one - 1.
- two.
- three.
```

## Expected Behavior

Same.
